cinematography.lens: High-end 3D animated feature film cinematography, 50mm prime, soft cinematic depth of field, f/1.8
cinematography.color_grading: Pixar-style rich cinematic palette, warm golden dust motes, deep ambient occlusion, and pristine metallic specular reflections
cinematography.lighting_setup: Volumetric sunset rim-light filtering through tall workshop windowpanes, casting long soft shadows

subjects.name: Little Robot
subjects.appearance: Charming, weathered yellow-painted little robot with large round expressive optical glass lenses, articulated mechanical fingers, and cute antenna
subjects.anatomical_constraints: Rigid metallic joint articulation, realistic scratched painted metal shaders with subsurface edge wear, and crystal-clear reflective glass lens eyes
subjects.kinematics: Gentle mechanical servo head tilt, delicate three-finger metallic grip holding a small glowing memory core crystal, and subtle emotional shoulder slump

environment_and_props.setting: Atmospheric retro-futuristic robot repair workshop filled with glowing gears, copper pipes, and soft floating dust particles at golden hour
environment_and_props.props_physics: Glowing amber memory crystal casting dynamic soft point-light illumination on the robot's chest plate and metallic fingers

timeline.framing: Cinematic 3D medium shot with subtle emotional push-in
timeline.action: The cute little yellow robot rolls forward on small rubber tracks, searching through workshop shelves, holding up a glowing amber crystal with his metallic fingers. He looks around anxiously and speaks in a sweet, heartfelt robotic voice:

timeline.framing: Match-on-action cut to an emotional close-up portrait of the robot's face
timeline.action: Camera frames his expressive glowing blue lens eyes dilating with sorrow; the crystal in his small hands pulses gently, reflecting golden light across his yellow metal cheek as a single tiny drop of blue fluid glides like a tear down his chassis.

audio_soundscape.diegetic_foley: Cute whirring servo motors, delicate metallic clinks of small rubber tracks over copper floor plates, soft electronic robot chirps, and the gentle harmonic hum of the glowing crystal.
audio_soundscape.non_diegetic_music: Heartwarming Pixar-style orchestral score with emotional acoustic piano melody, tender solo oboe, and lush soaring strings that fade out gently.
